name: Cernan Wild Vale
passives: Living Grove — Cernan's Mastery: Cernan's Living Grove: a solo zone conversion that grows when the Titan uses roots, moonlit growth, and fae paths to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Cernan Wild Vale is a colossal Tuatha Titan shaped by the living world adapts and endures. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Emerald, silver, living wood, ancient stones, roots, bark-bronze skin, antler crowns, moonlit grove power. The silhouette must be colossal, non-human, readable on mobile, and unmistakably Tuatha.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Cernan Restoring Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Verdant damage at range 2; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from living terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Moonwell Renewal Circuit
abilityDetails.effect: Apply cleanse, heal-over-time, attrition defense; also builds 10 Grove Pulse when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread formations, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Cernan Wild Vale: Survival Covenant
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Grove Pulse to create a two-round battlefield rule around living terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Moonwell Verdant Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Grove Pulse, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Tuatha Moonwell Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +2 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Cernan Wild Vale Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +2 armor and +3 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Cernan Grove Pulse Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Grove Pulse cap +20. At 80+ Grove Pulse, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Grove Pulse.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: win attrition and cleanse hazard pressure
